documentation.description: This table contains the raw data of users from Zomato.

sql.query:
select 
    user_id::number as customer_id, 
    name as customer_name, 
    lower(email) as email,
    try_to_number(age) as age, 
    gender, 
    marital_status, 
    occupation,
    monthly_income as income_band, 
    education, 
    try_to_number(family_size) as family_size
from ZOMATO.RAW.users where try_to_number(user_id) is not null

documentation.description: This table contains the raw data of menus from Zomato.

sql.query:
select 
    menu_id, 
    try_to_number(r_id) as restaurant_id, 
    f_id, 
    cuisine, 
    try_to_decimal(price,10,2) as price
from ZOMATO.RAW.menu where try_to_number(r_id) is not null and try_to_decimal(price,10,2) > 0

documentation.description: This table contains the raw data of restaurants from Zomato.

sql.query:
-- parse the messy dimension (-- →null, 50+ ratings→50, ₹ 200→200, city after last comma):

select 
    id::number as restaurant_id, 
    name as restaurant_name,
    trim(coalesce(regexp_substr(city, '[^,]+$'), city)) as city,
    try_to_decimal(nullif(rating, '--'), 3, 1) as rating,
    try_to_number(regexp_substr(rating_count, '[0-9]+')) as rating_count,
    try_to_number(regexp_substr(cost, '[0-9]+')) as cost_for_two,
    cuisine, 
    lic_no as license_no
from ZOMATO.RAW.restaurants where try_to_number(id) is not null

documentation.description: This table contains the raw data of food items from Zomato.

sql.query:
select 
    f_id, 
    item as food_name, 
    initcap(veg_or_non_veg) as veg_or_non_veg
from ZOMATO.RAW.food where f_id is not null

documentation.description: This table contains the raw data of order items from Zomato.

sql.query:
select 
    order_item_id, 
    order_id, 
    r_id as restaurant_id, 
    f_id, 
    price::decimal(10,2) as price, 
    quantity::number as quantity, 
    line_amount::decimal(10,2) as  line_amount
from ZOMATO.RAW.order_items

documentation.description: This table contains the raw data of orders from Zomato.

sql.query:
select 
    order_id, 
    order_timestamp, 
    order_date, 
    user_id as customer_id, 
    r_id as restaurant_id,
    trim(coalesce(regexp_substr(restaurant_city, '[^,]+$'), restaurant_city)) as city,
    cuisine, 
    items_count, 
    sales_qty, 
    subtotal,
    discount, 
    delivery_fee, 
    gst, 
    sales_amount,
    currency, 
    payment_method, 
    order_status, 
    (order_status='Delivered') as is_delivered,
    customer_rating, 
    delivery_time_min
from ZOMATO.RAW.orders

with spine as (
    select dateadd(day, seq4(), '2024-01-01'::date) as date_day 
    from 
    table(generator(rowcount=>1200))
)
select 
    date_day, 
    year(date_day) as year, 
    month(date_day) as month, 
    monthname(date_day) as month_name,
    dayname(date_day) as day_name, 
    (dayofweekiso(date_day)>=6) as is_weekend
from spine where date_day <= '2026-12-31'

documentation.description: This table contains the raw data of reviews from Zomato.

sql.query:
select
    r.review_id,
    r.order_id,
    r.user_id::number as customer_id,
    r.restaurant_id::string as restaurant_id,
    r.rating::number as rating,
    r.comment::string as comment,
    r.review_date::DATE as review_date,
    res.city as city,
from ZOMATO.RAW.reviews r
left join ZOMATO.staging.stg_restaurants res 
on r.restaurant_id = res.restaurant_id
where r.comment is not null

select 
    f_id, 
    food_name, 
    veg_or_non_veg 
from ZOMATO.staging.stg_food

select 
    restaurant_id, 
    restaurant_name, 
    city, 
    cuisine, 
    rating, 
    rating_count, 
    cost_for_two
from ZOMATO.staging.stg_restaurants

select
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    email,
    age,
    CASE 
        WHEN age < 25 then 'Gen Z'
        WHEN age < 40 then 'Millennial'
        WHEN age < 55 then 'Gen X'
        WHEN age is null then 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Boomer' 
    END as age_segment,
    gender,
    marital_status,
    occupation,
    income_band,
    education,
    family_size
from ZOMATO.staging.stg_users

select 
    oi.order_item_id, 
    oi.order_id, 
    oi.restaurant_id, 
    oi.f_id, 
    o.order_timestamp as order_ts,
    o.order_date, 
    o.city,
    oi.price, 
    oi.quantity, 
    oi.line_amount
from ZOMATO.staging.stg_order_items oi
inner join ZOMATO.staging.stg_orders o using (order_id)


  where o.order_timestamp > (select coalesce(max(order_ts),'1900-01-01'::timestamp) from ZOMATO.marts.fact_order_items)

select 
    order_id, 
    order_timestamp, 
    order_date, 
    customer_id, 
    restaurant_id,
    city, 
    cuisine,
    payment_method, 
    order_status, 
    is_delivered, 
    items_count, 
    sales_qty, 
    subtotal, 
    discount,
    delivery_fee, 
    gst, 
    sales_amount, 
    customer_rating, 
    delivery_time_min
from ZOMATO.staging.stg_orders


  where order_timestamp > (select coalesce(max(order_timestamp),'1900-01-01'::timestamp) from ZOMATO.marts.fct_orders)

select 
    order_date, 
    city, 
    count(*) as orders, 
    count_if(is_delivered) as delivered_orders,
    round(div0(count_if(order_status='Cancelled'), count(*)),4) as cancel_rate,
    sum(iff(is_delivered, sales_amount, 0)) as gmv,
    round(div0(sum(iff(is_delivered, sales_amount,0)), count_if(is_delivered)),2) as aov
from ZOMATO.marts.fct_orders group by 1,2

select city, 
    hour(order_timestamp) as order_hour, 
    count_if(is_delivered) as delivered_orders,
    round(median(delivery_time_min),1) as p50, 
    round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by delivery_time_min),1) as p90
from ZOMATO.marts.fct_orders 
where is_delivered group by 1,2

select 
    f.restaurant_id, 
    r.restaurant_name, 
    r.city, 
    r.cuisine, 
    count(*) as orders,
    sum(iff(f.is_delivered, f.sales_amount, 0)) as revenue, 
    round(avg(f.customer_rating),2) as avg_customer_rating,
    round(avg(f.delivery_time_min),1) as avg_delivery_min
from ZOMATO.marts.fct_orders f 
left join ZOMATO.marts.dim_restaurants r using (restaurant_id) 
group by 1,2,3,4
